messages:
alex: quick check — I found an old service token for svc-worker-prod stored at `secret/data/services/svc-worker-prod/token` in Vault. last-used shows 2023-10-01, looks orphaned. pinging security for guidance.

maria: can you paste the exact vault path and which policy/role owns it? also did it surface in logs or just the metadata?

alex: path above. I grepped logs and saw one snippet with an auth header that looks like an unredacted token. command I ran: `grep -R \"sk_live_\" /var/log/* | head -n 5`. found: ```[2024-11-02T14:22:01Z] svc-worker: auth failed: token sk_live_Abc123XYZ used from 10.2.3.4``` — the token is masked at source now but that file still has the token.

kai: @alex thanks. can you check who created the token? likely deploy-bot or CI. if it's deploy-bot we should rotate and update the bot config.

alex: UI shows created_by = deploy-bot-integration, comment field empty. deploy-bot has two active tokens. no recent owner maintainer note.

sam: action plan suggestion: create a new wrapped token, update the deployment to read new token from Vault, promote canary, then revoke old token. also run a log-scrub sweep for any copies. @security-oncall any objections?

security-oncall: agree with that plan. recommended steps: 1) create new token in Vault with KMS key wrapping (prevent plaintext export), 2) update staging config and do a canary deploy, 3) revoke old token from Vault, 4) run automated log-scrub and open an audit ticket. also please add an incident tag if you see any external use.

maria: small tip for scrub: you can run `sed -E 's/(sk_live_)[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+/\1[REDACTED]/g' app.log > app.redacted.log` and then rotate the log. also add a redact rule to our log pipeline (rsyslog/nginx filter) so tokens are redacted before ingest.

alex: I'll schedule rotation tonight at 23:00 UTC. I'll create ticket INF-987 and post the runbook there. anyone free to watch canary?

kai: I can watch the canary at 23:00 UTC. ping me 15m before.

maria: after rotation, run `vault audit list` to confirm access entries and `gcloud kms keys versions list --key=redwood-wrap-key` (or the equivalent HSM command) to confirm wrapping activity. also add a note to the secrets onboarding doc to avoid long-lived bot tokens.

security-oncall: extra check: if the previous token was exported or used outside infra, we'll need to rotate any downstream credentials. check HSM import logs: `gcloud kms operations list` or `vault audit tail` depending on flow. create a short post-mortem if we find copies.

deploy-bot: automated note: deploy-bot observed a rotation request for svc-worker-prod; will queue a deploy upon explicit approval in INF-987.

alex: thanks all — I'll update INF-987 with steps, links to the vault path, and the scrub command. tagging this thread done-for-now until I post the ticket. :white_check_mark:
